newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank happy to see T$ fall - paper.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank happy to see T$ fall - paper.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank was pleased with the Taiwan dollar's recent "appropriate" depreciation as it could help boost exports, the local Economic Daily News reported on Wednesday.
The paper quoted an unnamed central bank official as saying the Taiwan dollar must depreciate in an orderly way and the bank would not allow speculation to destabilise the market.
A central bank spokesman declined to comment.

The Taiwan dollar has depreciated 0.6 percent so far in May against the U.S. dollar, far lower than the depreciation degree by other trade competitors' currencies against the greenback, leaving more room for the local dollar's further depreciation, the paper said.
On Tuesday, the Taiwan dollar ended down at T$27.836 against Monday's T$27.819 close.
